en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a small chapel with a tall steeple and cross, surrounded by leafless trees and a nearby building. At the bottom in red script it reads "Pensionat-Hauskapelle. Feldhof bei Graz." There is a purple circular stamp on the lower right reading "STEIERM. LANDES-ARCHIV" and the year "1903" printed beside it. Along the left border is a vertical imprint with the name and address of a printer in Graz.
